## History

Fiske worked as a travelling evangelist and held meetings at the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) five years prior. During that time, he pretended to be a [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) while secretly being a [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P0](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P2](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P7](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P9](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P10](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P11](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0011), +13 more_
